lines.en: : Ami, where are you taking me?
lines.zh: : Ami,你要带我去哪?

lines.en: : I told you the first ten times you asked! Somewhere you’re going to like! The answer hasn’t changed!
lines.zh: : 前十次你都问过了!是一个你会喜欢的地方!答案没有变!

lines.en: : I just can’t help but feel like you are lying to me considering every single building I can see from here sells nothing but anime and nerd stuff.
lines.zh: : 可我总感觉你在骗我——因为从这里望过去,目之所及的每一栋楼都只卖动画和宅物。

lines.en: : Okay, first off, Sensei...anime isn’t just for nerds and I know you’re better than thinking that.
lines.zh: : 好吧,第一,Sensei……动画不只是给宅男的,我知道你不会那么想。

lines.en: : Am I really, though?
lines.zh: : 我真的不会吗?

lines.en: : We used to watch Sailor Moon all the time when I was little!
lines.zh: : 我小时候,我们可是天天一起看美少女战士!

lines.en: : So obviously I would still love it years later.
lines.zh: : 所以多年以后的我,当然还爱它。

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 完美论证。

lines.en: : That was sarcasm.
lines.zh: : 刚才那句是反讽。

lines.en: : Your face is sarcasm. Now stop asking where we’re going and let me lead the way!
lines.zh: : 你的脸才是反讽。别再问我们去哪了,乖乖跟我走!

lines.en: Ami pulls me through the streets of the red-ish light entertainment district after a mildly long bus ride back from the cemetery.
lines.zh: 从墓园坐了很久的公交回来后,Ami 拉着我穿过这条灯色偏红的娱乐街区。

lines.en: Is this where I expected to come immediately succeeding one of the most emotional moments I have witnessed in the last...forever? No.
lines.zh: 在见证了我此生……不对,是永恒以来最动情的时刻之后,这里是我预期中的下一站吗?不是。

lines.en: But I guess it will, to some extent, numb some of the pain she must be feeling right now.
lines.zh: 但我猜,这多少能麻一麻她此刻必定在承受的痛。

lines.en: Besides, indulging in her interests every now and again might not be the worst thing ever in exchange for a guaranteed life worth of smooth sailing and even smoother omelets.
lines.zh: 再说了,偶尔纵容一下她的爱好,换来今后一辈子顺风顺水、外加煎蛋卷格外顺滑的日子,也不算最坏的交易。

lines.en: I just hope we don’t have to spend the entire day here. I don’t like that a place as loud and bright as this is on the brink of becoming another regular location for me.
lines.zh: 我只希望不用在这里耗一整天。我不喜欢这么吵这么亮的地方,眼看就要变成我的又一个日常据点。

lines.en: And I also don’t like that we are now walking into a nerd store.
lines.zh: 我也不喜欢我们正在走进一家宅物店。

lines.en: : So, as you can see, I lied to you.
lines.zh: : 那么,如你所见,我骗了你。

lines.en: : Betrayed by my own [niece].
lines.zh: : 被自己的 [niece] 背叛了。

lines.en: : Aren’t you the one who is supposed to always be on my side?
lines.zh: : 你不是应该永远站在我这边吗?

lines.en: : I am on your side! I just knew that you wouldn’t come here with me if I told you the truth about where we were going, and the new volume of a manga I like came out today.
lines.zh: : 我就是站在你这边!只是我清楚,要是我说实话,你肯定不肯跟我来——而我喜欢的漫画,新刊今天发售。

lines.en: : There’s no [incest] in it at all.
lines.zh: : 里面完全没有 [incest]。

lines.en: : I mean, what? Who said that?
lines.zh: : 我是说,什么?谁说的?

lines.en: : Oh, look! New figures!
lines.zh: : 哦,看!新手办!

lines.en: : Did you really have to come here today? Shouldn’t we have done something at least partially enjoyable for me?
lines.zh: : 你非得今天来吗?我们不该先干点至少对我而言算有趣的事吗?

lines.en: : Oh, come on! We won’t be here long. I’m using my own money and everything.
lines.zh: : 哦,拜托!不会待很久的。我用的是自己的钱,而且一切。

lines.en: : I just need to pick this up before all the new copies sell out and then we can go out and have our cute family date that I’m definitely not pretending is a real date and that we’re going to get married.
lines.zh: : 我只是要在新刊售罄之前把它买到手,然后我们就可以去过我们可爱的家庭约会了——我绝对没有假装这是一场真约会、假装我们会结婚。

lines.en: : I mean, what? Who keeps saying all of these weird things out of literally nowhere?
lines.zh: : 我是说,什么?这些莫名其妙的话都是谁在说?

lines.en: : Ami, I think you have a problem.
lines.zh: : Ami,我觉得你有点毛病。

lines.en: : It’s not me who’s wrong. It’s society.
lines.zh: : 错的不是我。是这个世界。

lines.en: : Now, come with me and don’t look at the back section of the store.
lines.zh: : 现在,跟我来,不许看店铺的后半区。

lines.en: : Why can’t I look at the back section of the store?
lines.zh: : 为什么不能看店铺后半区?

lines.en: : I will tell you when you’re older.
lines.zh: : 等你长大了再告诉你。

lines.en: : Over here, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 这里这里,Sensei!

lines.en: : I’m more than twice your age. I think.
lines.zh: : 我岁数是你的两倍还多。大概。

lines.en: : How old are you again, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你今年多大来着,Ami?

lines.en: : Old enough! But that’s not a thing we should be yelling about in the store and you should probably come over here now!
lines.zh: : 够大了!但这种事不适合在店里喊,而且你现在应该马上过来!

lines.en: I swallow the last few shreds of pride in my body (If that’s where pride is stored) and make my way over to Ami as she sifts through a bunch of brightly colored boxes and books.
lines.zh: 我咽下体内最后的几丝尊严(如果尊严是存在那里的话),朝 Ami 走去——她正在一堆色彩鲜艳的盒子和书里翻拣。

lines.en: And, despite apparently knowing exactly what she is here for, she sure takes her time in picking up and observing a lot of different items.
lines.zh: 而尽管她显然非常清楚自己来干什么,她挑挑拣拣、翻看各种商品所花的功夫,可真不少。

lines.en: Have I been lied to again in such quick succession?
lines.zh: 我是不是又很快被骗了第二次?

lines.en: Is this the so-called “rebellious phase” I have heard of?
lines.zh: 这就是我听说过的所谓「叛逆期」吗?

lines.en: Is there a cut-off for when you can put someone up for adoption? Is that still a possibility if this keeps up?
lines.zh: 把孩子送去领养,还有截止日期吗?照这个势头,这条路还走得通吗?

lines.en: : You know, Sensei, I can probably find something here for you if you want me to.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,Sensei,你要是乐意,我大概还能在这儿帮你挑点什么。

lines.en: : And why would I want you to do that, exactly?
lines.zh: : 我为什么要让你帮我挑,理由呢?

lines.en: : Because...manga is more interesting than standing around and doing nothing all day?
lines.zh: : 因为……漫画总比整天站着无所事事有意思吧?

lines.en: : I don’t do “nothing” all day. You clearly don’t understand the first thing about how exciting my life is.
lines.zh: : 我可没有整天「无所事事」。你显然完全不了解我的人生有多精彩。

lines.en: : If it’s so exciting how come you haven’t smiled in like six million years?
lines.zh: : 要是那么精彩,你怎么大概六百万年没笑过了?

lines.en: : I’m just waiting for the right moment.
lines.zh: : 我只是在等合适的时机。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Sure you are.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。是是是。

lines.en: : Really, though! There’s tons of stuff here I think you would like! And I’m not just saying that because I think it would be nice to share a hobby with you.
lines.zh: : 说真的!这里好多东西我觉得你都会喜欢!而且我说这话可不是因为想和你共享一个爱好什么的。

lines.en: : Niki told me about how you two used to watch anime together, so what if we got you something...retro? Like something you guys watched way back when?
lines.zh: : Niki 跟我说过,你们俩以前会一起看动画——那要不给你挑点……复古的?就你们当年一起看过的那种?

lines.en: : They even remake more popular series that have been out of style for a while sometimes. I’m sure I can find-
lines.zh: : 有些退环境的人气系列,他们有时候还会出重制版。我肯定能找到——

lines.en: : I’m going to stop you right there at the risk of you making me feel even older than I constantly feel around you.
lines.zh: : 打住,免得你把我搞得更老——虽然我在你身边本来就天天觉得自己老。

lines.en: : If it makes you feel any better, I probably wouldn’t like you as much if you weren’t so much older and bigger than me.
lines.zh: : 好吧,要是能让你舒服点——你要不是比我大这么多、块头这么壮,我可能还没那么喜欢你。

lines.en: : I mean, what? Really, where are all of these comments coming from?
lines.zh: : 我是说,什么?说真的,这些话到底都是从哪冒出来的?

lines.en: : I’m gonna get you something. I’ve decided.
lines.zh: : 我决定了,我要送你一样东西。

lines.en: : And I’ve decided that you’re not going to do that.
lines.zh: : 而我也决定了,你不许这么做。

lines.en: : But it’s a present! I never got you anything for Christmas. Are you really going to turn away a free thing that your [niece] lovingly selected for you?
lines.zh: : 可这是礼物!圣诞节我从来没送过你东西。你的 [niece] 满怀爱意给你挑的免费礼物,你真的要拒收吗?

lines.en: : Yes.
: What kind of genre do you want? Action? Drama? BL?
lines.zh: : 那你想要什么类型?热血?剧情?BL?

lines.en: : What is BL?
lines.zh: : 什么是 BL?

lines.en: : BL is-
lines.zh: : BL 是——

lines.en: : What’s this?! Time for another weebnote?!
lines.zh: : 这是什么?!又到 weebnote 环节了吗?!

lines.en: : Oh. Molly’s here.
lines.zh: : 哦。Molly 来了。

lines.en: : That makes sense.
lines.zh: : 这就说得通了。

lines.en: : BL, or “boys love” is a wildly underappreciated genre in the anime and manga world where, get this- boys love each other!
lines.zh: : BL,也就是「boys love」,是动画与漫画世界中被严重低估的题材——注意了——讲的是男孩们相爱!

lines.en: : Why would you even suggest that for me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要给我推荐这个?

lines.en: : Because I think it’d be hot.
lines.zh: : 因为我觉得会很带感。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Did you know that BL manga dates all the way back to the mid-70’s? It hasn’t changed much since then and is still aimed primarily at young girls, but the origins were actually much darker!
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,BL 漫画的历史能追溯到七十年代中期?从那以后变化不大,目标读者也依然是少女,但它的起源其实黑暗得多!

lines.en: : Kaze to Ki no Uta, which is commonly referred to as the first instance of the BL genre, features stuff like prostitution, drug usage, and ra-
lines.zh: : 《风与木之诗》,公认的第一部 BL 作品,里面包含卖淫、嗑药、还——

lines.en: : Uhh...actually, that’s it for today’s weebnote. I don’t really have anything else to say.
lines.zh: : 呃……好了,今天的 weebnote 就到这里。我没别的要说了。

lines.en: : What brings you here, Molly? I thought you and Tsuneyo were supposed to hang out today.
lines.zh: : Molly,你怎么在这儿?你不是约了 Tsuneyo 吗?

lines.en: : I am Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我就是 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Surprise. I am also here.
lines.zh: : 惊喜。我也在场。

lines.en: : I’m assuming you were dragged along unwillingly as well?
lines.zh: : 我猜你也是被硬拽来的?

lines.en: : Not at all, Sir. It was actually Tsuneyo’s idea to come here, not mine. I spent everything I currently have on gacha games, so I’m only here to act as a consult today.
lines.zh: : 完全不是,先生。来这里其实是 Tsuneyo 的主意,不是我的。我现有的全部积蓄都氪进抽卡游戏了,所以今天我只是担任顾问。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo’s finally getting into manga?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 终于入坑漫画了?

lines.en: : I received a Christmas bonus from my father and feel the need to spend it on things I am supposed to appreciate before it is too late and he asks for it back.
lines.zh: : 我收到了父亲发的圣诞奖金,觉得必须在「来不及」之前,把钱花在那些我理应欣赏的东西上——否则他要把钱要回去。

lines.en: : I don’t think employers ever ask for bonuses back, but I guess I don’t know your dad all that well.
lines.zh: : 雇主一般不会把奖金要回去吧。不过我对你爸确实不太了解。

lines.en: : He does not like summer very much. I will not squander this opportunity to buy a brightly colored rectangle.
lines.zh: : 他非常不喜欢夏天。我不会浪费这次机会,要买下一本色彩鲜艳的长方形。

lines.en: : How about you, Ami? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: :那你呢,Ami?你来这里干什么?

lines.en: : The new volume of My Sweet Prince came out today and I wanted to make sure I got it before it was sold out.
lines.zh: : 《我的甜蜜王子》新刊今天发售,我想确保在售罄之前拿到。

lines.en: : My Sweet Prince? Isn’t that the one where the girl and her uncle-
lines.zh: : 《我的甜蜜王子》?不就是那个女孩和她叔叔——

lines.en: : Oh my god.
lines.zh: : 我的天。

lines.en: : Hmm hm hmmmm~
lines.zh: : 嗯哼嗯哼嗯嗯~

lines.en: In a strange twist of fate, it looks like Ami lied again and that the book she’s buying very much has the one thing she told me it didn’t have.
lines.zh: 命运出现了奇妙的转折:看来 Ami 又撒谎了——她买的那本书里,恰恰满满都是她坚称不存在的那种东西。

lines.en: : Well I guess that confirms that suspicion.
lines.zh: : 好吧,这下那个怀疑算是坐实了。

lines.en: : Just liking a certain trope in manga doesn’t mean you like it in real life, Molly. Everybody knows that.
lines.zh: : 喜欢漫画里的某种桥段,不代表现实中也会喜欢,Molly。这是常识。

lines.en: : It normally does, though.
lines.zh: : 但一般都会。

lines.en: : I won’t confirm nor deny anything.
lines.zh: : 我不确认,也不否认任何事。

lines.en: : I take it that means you two are...on a...date then?
lines.zh: : 那我理解为,你们俩这是在……约……会咯?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : Mm!
: Wait. Now I’m confused. Is this not a meeting of secret, forbidden love? A taste testing of the most bitter fruit of all?
lines.zh: : 等等,我糊涂了。这难道不是秘密禁忌之爱的会面吗?品尝世上最苦之果的时刻?

lines.en: : I believe that would be the “bitter melon,” which is famous for its medicinal properties.
lines.zh: : 那应该是「苦瓜」,以药用价值闻名。

lines.en: : We’re just stopping by on our way back from...a place.
lines.zh: : 我们只是顺路过来……从一个地方回来的路上。

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 这话……

lines.en: : You know that makes it sound even sketchier...don’t you, Sir?
lines.zh: : 你知道这么说听起来更可疑了……对吧,先生?

lines.en: : I don’t know where your depraved mind goes after just hearing the word “place,” but I can assure you it’s not whatever you’re thinking.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你堕落的脑子听到「地方」两个字能想到什么,但我保证,绝对不是你想的那种。

lines.en: : I doubt Ami wants to talk about it, though, so let’s just move on and-
lines.zh: : 不过 Ami 大概不想聊这个,我们就翻篇吧,然后——

lines.en: : I wanted to see my mom.
lines.zh: : 我去看妈妈了。

lines.en: : I’ve just missed her a lot lately. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是最近很想念她。就这样。

lines.en: : Which is why we’re now...counteracting that with some place happy and...
lines.zh: : 所以我们现在……正用某个开心的地方中和一下,然后……

lines.en: : May I hug you?
lines.zh: : 我能抱抱你吗?

lines.en: : Yes, please.
lines.zh: : 好呀,求之不得。

lines.en: Molly wraps her arms around Ami and pulls her close, pressing their heads together.
lines.zh: Molly 张开手臂环住 Ami,把她拉近,两人额头相抵。

lines.en: They gaze into each other’s eyes and, if this weren’t such a heartfelt moment, I’d probably say something to emphasize just how much I’d appreciate it if the two of them would kiss right now.
lines.zh: 她们彼此凝视。要不是此刻这么动情,我多半会插一句嘴,强调一下她们俩现在就亲上一个的话,我会多么欣赏那一幕。

lines.en: Which is obviously not a thing I’m going to talk about.
lines.zh: 这种话我显然不会说出口。

lines.en: I mean, how could anyone think that at a time like this?
lines.zh: 我是说,这种时候谁会想那种事?

lines.en: Nope. I don’t want that to happen at all.
lines.zh: 不会。我一点也不想看到那种事发生。

lines.en: Not even a little.
lines.zh: 一点也不想。

lines.en: Not even a little.
lines.zh: 一点也不想。

lines.en: : I lost my mom when I was little, too. I know what it’s like.
lines.zh: : 我小时候也失去了妈妈。我懂那种感觉。

lines.en: : I know...I always wanted to ask you about how you managed to...talk about it so easily, but...it’s hard, you know?
lines.zh: : 我知道……我一直想问,你怎么能……那么轻易地聊起它,但是……很难,你懂吧?

lines.en: : I do. But you know what’s easier? Hugging. So I hereby give you permission to hug me any time you want as a free action.
lines.zh: : 我懂。但有件事更简单:拥抱。所以我在此授权,随时想抱我都可以,免抽耗。

lines.en: : Thank you, Molly. I’ll be here for you if you ever need me, too.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Molly。你要是需要,我也永远会在。

lines.en: : I’ll remember that.
lines.zh: : 我记下了。

lines.en: : Hey, how come we never do anything with just the two of us?
lines.zh: : 嘿,为什么我们从来没有单独出去玩过?

lines.en: : Probably because you already have Ayane and Maya and I would just be getting in the way.
lines.zh: : 大概因为你已经有 Ayane 和 Maya 了,我再插进去就纯属碍事。

lines.en: : Let’s hang out soon. Just us.
lines.zh: : 那我们约个时间出去玩吧。就我们俩。

lines.en: : I’d like that a lot...
lines.zh: : 那真的太好了……

lines.en: Not even a little.
lines.zh: 一点也不想。

lines.en: : It appears everyone has forgotten that I lack a mother as well.
lines.zh: : 看来大家都忘了,我也是没有妈妈的人。

lines.en: : Ah! I’m sorry, Kendo Princess! I just know that...your affinity for hugs is not as high as mine! And that you wouldn’t want to get involved in something like this...
lines.zh: : 啊!对不起,剑道公主!我只是知道……你对拥抱的热情没我高!而且你也不愿意掺和这种事……

lines.en: : And I just...wasn’t even thinking. Sorry, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 还有我就是……没过脑子。抱歉,Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Abandoned by my own party members. I truly am an outcast.
lines.zh: : 被自己的队友抛弃。我果然是局外人。

lines.en: : I’ll hug you, Tsuneyo. We don’t need them.
lines.zh: : 我来抱你,Tsuneyo。我们不需要他们。

lines.en: : I would rather die.
lines.zh: : 我宁可去死。

lines.en: : That...seems like an exaggeration.
lines.zh: : 这……反应有点过度了吧。

lines.en: : It is not.
lines.zh: : 并没有。

lines.en: : Didn’t we hug on Halloween that one time?
lines.zh: : 万圣节那次我们不是抱过吗?

lines.en: : I have no idea what you are talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : When-
lines.zh: : 什么时候——

lines.en: : I would never hug a man as horrible as you.
lines.zh: : 我绝不会拥抱你这种糟糕透顶的男人。

lines.en: : It was after we went outside and-
lines.zh: : 那时候我们出门之后——

lines.en: : Never.
lines.zh: : 绝无此事。

lines.en: : And Molly was-
lines.zh: : 而且 Molly 当时——

lines.en: : It would simply not happen.
lines.zh: : 那种事根本不可能发生。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Just give it a rest, Sir. Your charisma isn’t high enough to break through to Tsuneyo yet.
lines.zh: : 算了吧,先生。你的魅力值还不足以攻略 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : That’s fine, but...
lines.zh: : 行吧,不过……

lines.en: : How long are you two going to stay like that for?
lines.zh: : 你们俩打算这样抱到什么时候?

lines.en: : Maybe just a little bit longer.
lines.zh: : 也许……再抱一小会儿。

lines.en: : Ahh, youth...
lines.zh: : 啊,青春……

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, you’re the same age as them.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo,你跟她们同龄。

lines.en: : Then why will no one hug me?
lines.zh: : 那为什么没有人抱我?

lines.en: : I literally just offered-
lines.zh: : 我刚刚不是主动提了——

lines.en: : No thank you.
lines.zh: : 不必了,谢谢。

lines.en: : You smell really nice.
lines.zh: : 你身上好香。

lines.en: : I was actually just about to say the same thing to you.
lines.zh: : 我其实正想对你说同一句话。

lines.en: I guess Ami winds up mistaking Molly for a relative or something since it seems she has a hard time separating from her, but I’m sure it’s probably closer to the fact that she just has someone she can relate to.
lines.zh: 我猜 Ami 大概是把 Molly 错认成了哪个亲戚什么的,毕竟她好像特别舍不得松开她;但我确信,真相更接近于——她终于有了一个真正能共情的人。

lines.en: Even if Ayane’s mom isn’t around anymore, I can’t imagine Ami being able to confide in her in the way that she could with someone who’s actually felt the same sort of pain she has.
lines.zh: 就算 Ayane 的母亲也不在了,我依然想象不出 Ami 能像对着一个真正体会过同样痛苦的人那样,对 Ayane 倾诉。

lines.en: But pain is not something I intend to dwell on any longer when its abundance is one of many things in this life that neither myself nor anyone else is able to avoid.
lines.zh: 但痛苦不是我要继续纠缠的东西——这具人生里,痛苦的无处不在,是我和世上任何人都躲不开的众多事实之一。

lines.en: I will focus on the brighter things and what it is that illuminates them.
lines.zh: 我会把目光放在更明亮的事物上,以及那些照亮它们的光。

lines.en: Ami finds her manga (Which may or may not contain [incest], but probably does) and pays for it at the register after separating from the others.
lines.zh: Ami 找到了她的漫画(里面也许有 [incest],但多半有),和众人道别后去收银台结了账。

lines.en: She clutches it to her chest as the two of us exit the store together and make our way out into the street, bustling with foot traffic due to the sudden increase in temperature.
lines.zh: 她把漫画抱在胸口,和我一起走出店铺、汇入街面——气温骤升,街上人头攒动。

lines.en: Then, before long, she’s pulling me around once again.
lines.zh: 然后,没过多久,她又拽着我转向了别处。

lines.en: Just...
lines.zh: 只是……

lines.en: Hopefully to somewhere I won’t feel out of place in this time.
lines.zh: 希望这一次,是一个我不会格格不入的地方。

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!
